ترتضون (form VIII)
# تَرْتَضُونَ (tartaḍūna) /tar.ta.dˤuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَضَى (irtaḍā)
# تُرْتَضَوْنَ (turtaḍawna) /tur.ta.dˤaw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِرْتَضَى (irtaḍā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
